endpoints.description: Fetch one or more series by ID over a year range

limits.notes: Quota is per key — multiplexing risk, monitor usage

llmDocs.summary: US labor statistics: unemployment, CPI, wages, employment by industry and region.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Series IDs are structured codes, e.g. LAUCN040010000000005 = Local Area Unemployment, county-level. Prefix determines survey: LA=local unemployment, CU=CPI urban, CE=employment.
gotchas: No discovery endpoint — series IDs must be constructed or known

compliance.redistributionNotes: ToS prohibits sharing registration keys; centralized key use needs review
